title: Prenatal Alcohol Exposure and Congenital Heart Defects: A Meta-Analysis.
authors: Yang J, Qiu H, Qu P, Zhang R, Zeng L, Yan H.
quote: The results provided no evidence of the associa- tion between prenatal alcohol exposure and the risk of overall CHDs (OR = 1.06, 95%CI = 0.93-1.22), ventricular septal defects (VSDs) (OR = 1.04, 95%CI = 0.86 -1.25), or atrial sep- tal defects (ASDs) (OR = 1.40, 95%CI = 0.88 -2.23).
